newsitem.title: UK: NatWest up further on Abbey bid speculation.
newsitem.headline: NatWest up further on Abbey bid speculation.

text.p: Shares in National Westminster bank Plc extended their early gains by late morning on Friday amid speculation of a merger with Abbey National Plc, dealers said.

"It may just be idle talk in a quiet market, but NatWest has got a lot of upside if a deal goes through," said one senior equity salesman. "There is a lot of potential cost-cutting between the two and it could bring NatWest closer to the rating of Lloyds TSB."
At yesterday's close, NatWest was on a historic price-earnings ratio of 11.1 compared with Lloyds' 19.1.
NatWest shares were up 30-1/2p at 767-1/2 by 0950 GMT while Abbey shares were up 13-1/2p at 857.
Elsewhere in the sector, Barclays Plc was up 14-1/2p at 11.75 stg, Lloyds rose 7p at 595-1/2 and Royal Bank of Scotland Plc gained 5-1/2p at 606-1/2.
The equity salesman said investors should bear in mind recent merger plans between Guinness Plc and Grand Metropolitan Plc before dismissing talk in the bank sector.
"People would do well to remember the Guinness - Grand Met situation, six months after the deal was first mooted it went ahead."
